assertions.name: red_replays_recording
assertions.detail: uses the recording's milk and date

final_message:
I added a failing test, `test_an_item_that_runs_out_today_is_expiring`, in `tests/test_api.py`. I haven't committed it.

It replays the recording through the API. It adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and yogurt expiring 2026-10-23. Then it asks `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` and expects both items, milk first.

I ran the suite with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. The new test is the only failure out of 12. The response contains only the yogurt, which matches the recording.

The cause is in `Store.expiring` in `pantry/store.py`. It filters with `today < i.expires_on <= last`, and the strict `<` drops anything that expires today. I haven't changed it.
